This '''assassin droid''' was created prior to or during<ref name="Rogue Planet" /> [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> and its model was prone to killing their makers. This droid [[Death/Legends|killed]] one [[Unidentified student (Rigovian Technical University)|individual]] who was involved in the models design due to flaws in the model. This droid would later have its [[Verbobrain/Legends|verbobrain]] destroyed by [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]], and would be placed in the [[Raith Sienar's museum|personal]] [[Museum/Legends|museum]] of [[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar]], an [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] in the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who had attended the [[Rigovian Technical University]] alongside the student involved in the models design, as a reminder to not overstep one's competence.<ref name="Rogue Planet" />

==Behind the scenes==
This droid was first mentioned in [[Greg Bear]]'s ''[[Rogue Planet]]'', a novel released in [[May]] [[2000]].<ref name="Rogue Planet" />
